lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows along the lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple linear features extend horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a visible arrangement of approximately 6 distinct high-luminance blobs distributed across its lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin shows a high-density cluster of smaller, lower-intensity white spots along its anterior and lateral surfaces.
